capabilities: Sync text notes between devices through MongoDB or CouchDB
Auto-upload pasted local images to object storage and rewrite links
Resolve multi-device note conflicts with a manual comparison dialog
Upload large files like PDFs to object storage and track them by hash
Convert existing local image links to hosted image URLs
extras: README is largely in Chinese; installation requires cloning and building the repo from source; mobile support exists only with CouchDB, not MongoDB; the Configuration sections are empty placeholders.
motivation: The author wrote it to meet personal syncing needs ("根据自己的一些需求").
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through a self-hosted database or to keep large binary files out of the synced data.

requires.name: Tencent Cloud or Alibaba Cloud object storage

summary: Syncs notes across devices via a MongoDB or CouchDB database, with image uploading to object storage and manual conflict resolution.
